question: Can the published private demo registry be snapshotted and restored to a fresh isolated root with all canonical rows, history/provenance and exact artifact bytes intact, without changing the production service or source state?

initial_observations.observation: later read-only job found same PID and accepted tools; write denied

premises.statement: The fixed private registry is published non-WAL and has only the two reviewed synthetic records
The private CLI runtime has no writer tools and source state is readonly to that service
A content digest is integrity evidence, not scientific truth or independent qualification

unknowns: Current live state pending fresh baseline
Unobserved external writers would invalidate the quiescent-source premise
Original upgrade failure cause remains unestablished

hypotheses.prediction: Verified snapshot restores every indexed/historical canonical artifact and byte; UID982 can use the isolated private runtime.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any metadata/history/provenance/blob mismatch, tool failure or production state mutation.

hypotheses.prediction: A separately copied snapshot with a changed or missing blob is rejected before any restore target is published.
hypotheses.falsifier: Corrupt or incomplete snapshot produces a successful published restore.

measurements.name: isolated_runtime_tools
measurements.acceptance: health/context/math/research succeeds and job_submit is tool_not_allowed

measurements.name: corruption_negatives
measurements.acceptance: changed and missing blob both rejected

simplex.reason: Restore acceptance is exact equality and integrity, not a weighted mixture.
simplex.invariant_or_test: All required identities must match; no weighted partial pass.

n_ality.reason: Track independent DB metadata/history, blob content, filesystem publication and service-lifecycle axes.
n_ality.invariant_or_test: No one axis substitutes for another; every required axis must pass.

continuum.reason: Immutable discrete state recovery has no interpolation requirement.
continuum.invariant_or_test: No approximate or interpolated artifact bytes are accepted.

fuzzy_logic.reason: Integrity and permission decisions remain Boolean.
fuzzy_logic.invariant_or_test: No membership score can turn a mismatch into a pass.

bias_checks.trigger: Prior green runtime tests may encourage assuming recovery works
bias_checks.countermeasure: Require a new restore experiment and corrupted-snapshot negative controls

bias_checks.trigger: Snapshot producer and verifier may share a bug
bias_checks.countermeasure: Compare exact source/restore canonical rows and bytes through existing reader and actual Unix runtime; retain same-host/non-independent limit

bounds.registry_scope: two synthetic engineering context records only; cap counts/bytes before copying

authority.user_authorization: continue production and prior explicit deploy instruction; isolated own-service recovery work

recovery: Never point production to the drill. Terminate only the owned isolated child; preserve failed receipt/workspace. If source/PID/link/config changes, report failure and reconcile rather than repairing production blindly.
stopping_rule: One source-validated bounded live attempt after local negative tests. Preserve failures; diagnose concrete cause before any revised attempt.
